milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate to the building entrance and visually confirm the potted bamboo plants. Target is the midpoint (10, 1, 6) between the two pots at spawn-relative (~8,~1,~6) and (~12,~1,~6). max_distance reduced from 16 to 5 per CommonSenseAgent and ValidatorAgent feedback: the player spawns ~8 blocks away, so 5 blocks ensures they must actually walk to the entrance area rather than satisfying the milestone from near-spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the pots.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch_button causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The birch button is placed on the east interior wall at spawn-relative (~13, ~2, ~11) facing west. Buttons break instantly by hand (no tool required) and always drop themselves. The player starts with an empty inventory, so having >=1 birch_button confirms it was successfully mined.
